16112-edward-barnett-a-neglected-child-o.creator: Tobias Aconite,
16112-edward-barnett-a-neglected-child-o.description: A book by Tobias Aconite,. ith abstracts of the Game and Poor Law Enactments--its worn old chairs and heavy oak presses, the open doors of some of which disclosed bundles of old papers, parchments, etc.--this little room, the only one almost ever seen by any save the aristocracy and their followers--exercised and contained frequently more of human hope and fear than any other or the whole of the others of this sumptuous edifice.

824-speeches-literary-and-social.title: _Literary And Social_
824-speeches-literary-and-social.creator: Charles Dickens
824-speeches-literary-and-social.description: A book by Charles Dickens. Charles Dickens was intended by his father to be an attorney. John Dickens happily differed on that point. London law may have sustained little injury in losing Dickens for “a limb.”  English literature would have met with an irreparable loss, had she been deprived of him whom she delights to own as a favourite son.

arxiv-1705-02566.title: Identification of Stellar Sequences in various Stellar Systems : ESO65-SC03, TEUTSCH 106, TURNER 6 Journal: New Astronomy
arxiv-1705-02566.creator: Gireesh C. Joshi
arxiv-1705-02566.description: Abstract The spatial morphological study of studied clusters is carried out through the identified probable members within them. The field stars decontamination is performed by the statistical cleaning approach (depends on the magnitude and colour of stars within the field and cluster regions). The CMRD (colour magnitude ratio diagram) approach is used to separate stellar sequences of the cluster systems.

arxiv-1909-07080.title: On Machine Learning Force Fields for Metallic Nanoparticles
arxiv-1909-07080.creator: Claudio Zeni‘, Kevin Rossi, Aldo Glielmo, Francesca Baletto
arxiv-1909-07080.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Claudio Zeni‘, Kevin Rossi, Aldo Glielmo, Francesca Baletto. Machine learning algorithms have recently emerged as a tool to generate force fields which display accuracies approaching the ones of the ab-initio calculations they are trained on, but are much faster to compute. The enhanced computational speed of machine learning force fields results key for modelling metallic nanoparticles, as their fluxionality and multi-funneled energy landscape needs to be sampled over long time scales.

arxiv-2108-00175.description: Abstract Inflationary models derived from f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity, where the scalaron rolls down with a constant rate from the top to the minimum of the effective potential, are considered. Specifically, we take into account three f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) models i.e.

arxiv-2111-03114.title: Spin-networks in the ZX-calculus
arxiv-2111-03114.creator: Richard D.P. East, Pierre Martin-Dussaud, John Van de Wetering
arxiv-2111-03114.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Richard D.P. East, Pierre Martin-Dussaud, John Van de Wetering. The ZX-calculus, and the variant we consider in this paper, the ZXH-calculus, are formal diagrammatic languages for qubit quantum computing. In this paper we will show that this language can also be used to describe SU(2) representation theory.

arxiv-2304-09530.title: SelfAct : Personalized Activity Recognition based on Self-Supervised and Active Learning
arxiv-2304-09530.creator: Luca Arrotta, Gabriele Civitarese, Samuele Valente, Claudio Bettini
arxiv-2304-09530.description: Abstract Supervised Deep Learning (DL) models are currently the leading approach for sensor-based Human Activity Recognition (HAR) on wearable and mobile devices. However, training them requires large amounts of labeled data whose collection is often time-consuming, expensive, and error-prone. At the same time, due to the intra- and inter-variability of activity execution, activity models should be personalized for each user.

arxiv-2310-04563.title: Modeling the Risk of In-Person Instruction during the COVID-19 Pandemic
arxiv-2310-04563.creator: Brian Liu, Yujia Zhang, Shane G. Henderson, David B. Shmoys, Peter I. Frazier
arxiv-2310-04563.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Brian Liu, Yujia Zhang, Shane G. Henderson, David B. Shmoys, Peter I. Frazier. During the COVID-19 pandemic, safely implementing in-person indoor instruction was a high priority for universities nationwide. To support this effort at the University, we developed a mathematical model for estimating the risk of SARS-CoV-2 transmission in university classrooms.

arxiv-2310-13981.title: Filling the Missing: Exploring Generative AI for Enhanced Federated Learning over Heterogeneous Mobile Edge Devices
arxiv-2310-13981.creator: Peichun Li, Hanwen Zhang, Yuan Wu, Liping Qian, Rong Yu, Dusit Niyato, Xuemin (Sherman) Shen
arxiv-2310-13981.description: Abstract Distributed Artificial Intelligence (AI) model training over mobile edge networks encounters significant challenges due to the data and resource heterogeneity of edge devices. The former hampers the convergence rate of the global model, while the latter diminishes the devices’ resource utilization efficiency.

arxiv-2409-08728.title: Disentangling the sources of cyber risk premia
arxiv-2409-08728.creator: Loïc Maréchal and Nathan Monnet
arxiv-2409-08728.description: Abstract We use a methodology based on a machine learning algorithm to quantify firms’ cyber risks based on their disclosures and a dedicated cyber corpus. The model can identify paragraphs related to determined cyber-threat types and accordingly attribute several related cyber scores to the firm. The cyber scores are unrelated to other firms’ characteristics.

arxiv-2504-14941.title: WindVE: Collaborative CPU-NPU Vector Embedding DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: ACM Symposium on Parallelism in Algorithms and Architectures 2025; July 28-August 1, 2025; Portland, Oregon ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Computing methodologies Concurrent algorithms
arxiv-2504-14941.creator: Jinqi Huang, Xuebing Yu, Yi Xiong, Wenjie Huang, Entong Li, Li Zeng, Xin Chen
arxiv-2504-14941.description: Abstract . Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a technology that enhances large language models (LLMs) by integrating information retrieval. It uses vector embedding as a key technology to map queries to relevant information, enriching the context for text generation. This integration empowers LLMs to generate more coherent and well-informed content.

arxiv-2508-11793.title: Collective ballistic motion explains fast aggregation in adhesive active matter
arxiv-2508-11793.creator: Emanuel F. Teixeira, P. de Castro, Carine P. Beatrici, Heitor C. M. Fernandes, Leonardo G. Brunnet
arxiv-2508-11793.description: Abstract Inspired by motile cells during tissue formation, we identify a mechanism by which active systems of self-aligning adhesive particles undergo ballistic aggregation via a flocking transition. This kinetic regime emerges when the cluster persistence length grows faster with cluster mass than the intercluster distance does.

arxiv-2512-09335.title: Relightable and Dynamic Gaussian Avatar Reconstruction from Monocular Video Conference: Proceedings of the 33rd ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 27–31, 2025; Dublin, Ireland Proceedings of the 33rd ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’25), October 27–31, 2025, Dublin, I
arxiv-2512-09335.creator: Seonghwa Choi, Moonkyeong Choi, Mingyu Jang, Jaekyung Kim, Jianfei Cai, Wen-Huang Cheng, Sanghoon Lee
arxiv-2512-09335.description: Abstract . Modeling relightable and animatable human avatars from monocular video is a long-standing and challenging task. Recently, Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods have been employed to reconstruct the avatars. However, they often produce unsatisfactory photo-realistic results because of insufficient geometrical details related to body motion, such as clothing wrinkles.

pmc-10477950.title: PROTOCOL: The impact of infrastructure on low income consumers' nutritious diet, women's economic empowerment, and gender equality in low‐and middle‐income countries: An evidence and gap map
pmc-10477950.creator: Gloria Adobea Odei Obeng‐Amoako, Clarice Panyin Nyan, Joseph Clottey, Sheila Agyemang Oppong, Edward Kusi Asafo‐Agyei, Pacem Kotchofa, Charles Yaw Okyere, Solomon Zena Walelign, Takyiwaa Manuh, David Sarfo Ameyaw
pmc-10477950.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This is the protocol for an evidence and gap map. The objectives are as follows: this evidence and gap map (EGM) aims to identify, map, and provide an overview of the existing evidence and gaps on the impact of different types of physical infrastructure on various outcomes of low‐income consumers' nutritious diet, women's economic empowerment, and gender equality in low‐ and middle‐income countries.

pmc-10682026.title: Renewable diesel synthesis from sesame indicum (bene) seed oil using novel heterogeneous biocatalyst derived from the Chrysophyllum albidium seed coat
pmc-10682026.creator: Esonye Chizoo, Mbonu Felix Okechukwu, Onukwuli Okechukwu Dominic, Ani Amechi Kingsley, Augustine Simon Chimamkpam, Muodumogu Chiamaka Mariagorretti, Ezeagu Paschal Chinonso
pmc-10682026.description: The synthesis, characterization, optimization and oxidation stability improvement of biodiesel from the seed oil of sesame indicum using a novel nano-heterogeneous bio-catalyst derived from the Chrysophyllum albidium seed coat (CASC) is reported. The heterogeneous catalyst was produced by calcination and activation at 400 °C, 600 °C and 800 °C using acetic acid.

pmc-11372225.title: Post-extraction bleeding in patients on direct oral anticoagulants
pmc-11372225.creator: Min-Ji Kim, Moon-Key Kim, Sang-Hoon Kang
pmc-11372225.description: ObjectivesThis study aimed to evaluate the association between use of direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) and post-extraction bleeding and to quantify bleeding risk in patients receiving DOACs.Materials and MethodsThe study included 293 patients who were taking DOACs and underwent tooth extraction (414 teeth).

pmc-11439926.title: Reconstructing oral cavity tumor evolution through brush biopsy
pmc-11439926.creator: Evit John, Tom Lesluyes, Toby M Baker, Maxime Tarabichi, Ann Gillenwater, Jennifer R Wang, Peter Van Loo, Xiao Zhao
pmc-11439926.description: Oral potentially malignant disorders (OPMDs) with genomic alterations have a heightened risk of evolving into oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC). Currently, genomic data are typically obtained through invasive tissue biopsy. However, brush biopsy is a non-invasive method that has been utilized for identifying dysplastic cells in OPMD but its effectiveness in reflecting the genomic landscape of OPMDs remains uncertain.

pmc-11468308.title: Quercetin Attenuates MRGPRX2-Mediated Mast Cell Degranulation via the MyD88/IKK/NF-κB and PI3K/AKT/ Rac1/Cdc42 Pathway
pmc-11468308.creator: Chenrui Zhao, Yuanyuan Ding, Yihan Huang, Chao Wang, Bin Guo, Tao Zhang
pmc-11468308.description: BackgroundCMRF35-like molecule-1 (CLM-1) is a receptor of the CD300 family that inhibits MRGPRX2-mediated mast cell degranulation. Understanding the role and mechanism of CLM-1 agonist has significant implications for the treatment of allergic disease. Quercetin is a natural small molecule compound derived from plants and vegetables that has been shown to prevent histamine release by immune cells.

pmc-12452438.title: Documented vaccination as proof of immunity compared to serology in medical students
pmc-12452438.creator: Pere Godoy, Diana Toledo, Irma Casas, Karen Colmenares, Anna Vilella, Andreu Prat, Saray Mormeneo-Bayo, Rosa Bartolomé, Mercè Ibarz, Angela Domínguez, Working Group
pmc-12452438.description: We analyzed immunity to vaccine-preventable diseases and the predictive value of documented vaccination versus serological results for medical students in Catalonia (Spain). Epidemiological study of antibody seroprevalence and vaccination in medical students at four teaching units of medicine. Blood samples were drawn from participants who completed an epidemiology questionnaire.

pmc-12505554.title: Global, regional, and national burdens of early onset gastric cancer aged 15–49 years from 1990 to 2021 with projections to 2035: a population-based study
pmc-12505554.creator: Yi Lu, Jialin Wu, Tao Yang, Lei Lian, Honho Yu, Jiachen Sun, Jiancong Hu
pmc-12505554.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundEarly-onset gastric cancer (EOGC) is a distinct clinical entity with unique epidemiological and pathological features. Despite an overall decline in GC incidence in many regions, recent studies have shown an increasing trend in EOGC incidence in some areas.

pmc-12731609.title: NUMB in Endometrial Pathology: From Adenomyosis Expression Patterns to Endometrial Cancer Survival Implications
pmc-12731609.creator: Walid Shaalan, Nourhan Hassan, Mohamed Gamal Ibrahim, Benedikt Schäfgen, Kathrin Haßdenteufel, Julia Gallwas, Ludwig Kiesel, Andreas N. Schüring, Martin Götte
pmc-12731609.description: Adenomyosis, a prevalent gynecologic condition involving invasion of endometrial tissue into the myometrium, remains poorly understood in terms of its molecular pathogenesis. Numb, an important regulator of cellular destiny and stem cell maintenance, has been implicated in numerous proliferative diseases; however, the role for Numb in adenomyosis has not yet been investigated.

pmc-12803537.title: Unsupervised machine learning for cardiovascular disease: A framework for future studies
pmc-12803537.creator: Emmanuel Bresso, Claire Lacomblez, Kévin Duarte, Luca Monzo, Guillaume Baudry, Jasper Tromp, Abhinav Sharma, Nicolas Girerd
pmc-12803537.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Unsupervised machine learning can improve the characterization and stratification of patients with cardiovascular diseases (CVDs). Clustering algorithms, which group patients based on patterns in clinical data, can reveal distinct subgroups that may differ in prognosis and treatment response. Despite increasing research in this area, the practical use of clustering methods in routine clinical care remains limited by the lack of accessible tools and rigorous external validation. This review presents a systematic framework for applying unsupervised machine learning techniques to CVD research.

pmc-13384275.title: Association between autoimmune thyroiditis and BRAFV600E/TERT promoter mutations in patients with papillary thyroid carcinoma from Central Asia, Kazakhstan
pmc-13384275.creator: Saya Kaidarova, Zhanna Mussazhanova, Zhanna Kozykenova, Hirokazu Kurohama, Akbota Targynova, Altay Dyussupov, Zhanar Yeleubayeva, Masahiro Nakashima
pmc-13384275.description: BackgroundAutoimmune thyroiditis (AIT), including Hashimoto’s thyroiditis (HT) and Graves’ disease (GD), frequently coexists with papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC). Chronic inflammation may influence thyroid carcinogenesis; however, the relationship between AIT and aggressive molecular alterations in PTC, particularly BRAFV600E and TERT promoter mutations, remains unclear. Data from iodine-deficient regions such as Kazakhstan are limited.

pmc-13608917.title: News Fluorescence-Based Polarization Immunoassays as a Frontline Test for the Rapid Detection of Acute and Late Phase Lyme-Borreliosis Disease
pmc-13608917.creator: Joao P. R. S. Carvalho, Monica E. T. Alcón-Chino, Paloma Napoleão-Pêgo, Guilherme C. Lechuga, Isis C. Prado, Mariana S. Freitas, Jessica A. Waterman, Karyne Rangel, Salvatore G. De-Simone
pmc-13608917.description: Lyme borreliosis (LB) is a tick-borne disease caused by a diverse and expanding group of spirochetes characterized by complex biology and advanced immune evasion mechanisms. It presents a wide range of clinical symptoms affecting multiple organ systems and can lead to persistent complications.

pmc-13685118.title: Implementation strategies used in clinical practice guidelines in older adults’ mental health and neurocognitive conditions: a scoping review
pmc-13685118.creator: Stacey Hatch, Fardowsa Halane, Jessie McGowan, Jennifer Watt, Dallas P Seitz
pmc-13685118.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCaring for older adults with mental health conditions including neurocognitive conditions is complex. Clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) are intended to improve care for such conditions in older adults. This scoping review sought to systematically identify, synthesize, map evidence and identify the gaps in implementation strategies used in the implementation of CPGs for mental health conditions in older adults including neurocognitive conditions.MethodsThis scoping review was conducted using the JBI Manual for Evidence Synthesis methods for scoping reviews.

uslaw-usc-t54-s200301.title: 54 U.S.C. § 200301 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t54-s200301.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t54-s200301.description: United States Code, Title 54 (National Park Service And Related Programs); Chapter 2003 (Land And Water Conservation Fund). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter: (1) Fund.— The term “Fund” means the Land and Water Conservation Fund established under section 200302 of this title. (2) State.— The term “State” means a State, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, American Samoa.
